settings.name: Thread seal tape
settings.note: For a snug fit on the arm

settings.title: Unscrew
settings.text: Remove your current showerhead from the shower arm.

settings.title: Adapt
settings.text: Wrap the tape around the arm's thread and screw on the adapter.

settings.title: Connect
settings.text: Attach the hose to the adapter and the showerhead to the other end.

settings.title: Run it
settings.text: Set the head in the holder, run the water for 30 seconds, then shower as usual.

settings.a: Yes. The Complete Set includes the showerhead, a 1.5 m hose, an arm adapter with a built-in holder, thread seal tape and 5 cartridges.
It is made for standard shower arms with a standard thread. If you are unsure, check that your current showerhead unscrews from a threaded arm.
The Refill 3-Pack is $22.99 for 3 cartridges, about $7.66 each.

settings.q: How much is shipping and how long does it take?
settings.a: Shipping is free in the US. Orders ship in 7 to 15 business days.
